findings.entity: Front-left cup and gold coin (and rightmost cup at 00:06)
findings.description: After the man places a gold coin at the rim of the front-left opaque cup at 00:03, the coin renders directly on top of the nearer opaque exterior wall of the cup from 00:04 to 00:06 rather than being occluded inside the cup; a second coin similarly renders over the opaque front wall of the rightmost cup at 00:06.

At 00:05-00:06, the four cups are arranged in a wide colinear row spanning across the beige circle between the man's two hands. As the camera orbits slightly to the right between 00:06 and 00:07, the rightmost cup under his left hand disappears and a fourth cup emerges behind the leftmost cup, shifting the layout into a compact 2x2 cluster that is geometrically incompatible with the previous camera angle.
